newsitem.title: THAILAND: Chavalit expects to finalise Cabinet next week.
newsitem.headline: Chavalit expects to finalise Cabinet next week.

text.p: Thai coalition leader Chavalit Yongchaiyudh said on Thursday he expects to finalise his cabinet next week.
He spoke after his New Aspiration Party (NAP) nominated its deputy leader, Wan Muhamad Nor Matha, as the next speaker of parliament.
"The House's first sitting...is the first step in the process of forming the new administration, which I believe will be completed within next week," Chavalit told reporters after a NAP meeting.
The NAP won 125 of 393 seats in the lower House of Representatives in Sunday's general election, leaving party leader Chavalit set to become the next prime minister,
Sources said Chavalit was still haggling on Thursday with the five other parties in the coalition over the allocation of ministerial posts.

He was trying to end an impasse with the Chart Pattana Party over his support for Amnuay Viravan, a respected economist, as finance minister, sources said. Chart Pattana insists on having some control over economic policy.

If he wins election for parliament speaker when the new legislature convenes for its first sitting at the weekend, Wan Muhamad would be entrusted with nominating Chavalit as prime minister to King Bhumibol Adulyadej.
Wan Muhamad was communication and transport minister in the previous government.
Official Radio Thailand announced on Thursday that a royal decree had been issued for the parliament to convene on Saturday.
